subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw core define a stable per-user accounting subject and viewer authorization model for usage reporting, or should user-dimensional billing/quota reporting stay plugin/external for now?
rationale: Current main exposes usage by session, agent, channel, provider, model, and date, but the documented Gateway security model does not provide a tenant-style user authorization boundary for billing-grade per-user views.

options.title: Define core accounting subject first
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved identity, retention, and authorization contract before exposing per-user usage in core RPCs or UI.

options.title: Keep it plugin/external for now
options.body: Document the existing diagnostic/session usage primitives and leave multi-user spend reporting to external tooling or ClawHub plugins until the core product direction changes.

options.title: Narrow to session and agent visibility
options.body: Improve existing session, agent, channel, and provider reporting without promising per-user billing or quota semantics.

recommendation.title: Define core accounting subject first
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved identity, retention, and authorization contract before exposing per-user usage in core RPCs or UI.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current history across the usage RPC/UI and shared usage-helper surfaces that would need the product/security decision.
